verses.text: He i-a zis lui Moise, Come up to the DOMNUL, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise alone shall come near to the DOMNUL, but they shall not come near. The people shall not să plece up with him.

Moise came and told the people all the DOMNUL’s words, and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, and a zis, All the words which the DOMNUL has spoken will we do. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Moise wrote all the DOMNUL’s words, then rose up early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain, with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to the DOMNUL. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they a zis, We will do all that the DOMNUL has a zis, and be obedient. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Moise took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and a zis, Look, this is the blood of the covenant, which the DOMNUL has made with you concerning all these words. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Then Moise, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
They saw the Dumnezeu of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire stone, like the skies for clearness. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He didn’t lay his mână on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw Dumnezeu, and ate and drank.

The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written, that you may teach them. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moise went up onto Dumnezeu’s Mountain. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He i-a zis lui the elders, Wait here for us, until we come again to you. Behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever is involved in a dispute can să plece to them.
Moise went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. The seventh day he called to Moise out of the middle of the cloud. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The appearance of the DOMNUL’s glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moise was on the mountain forty days and forty nights. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
